_meta.item_selection: all TEST one-frame items in bank order
_meta.prefill_detection: transformers 5.14.1: generate() = one prefill forward over the full left-padded prompt (_prefill; prefill_chunk_size asserted None) then one seq_len-1 forward per new token; hooks act on their FIRST call, assert seq_len == prompt length there and == 1 afterwards, calls == generated tokens, no hook left registered
_meta.staging: per-item right-aligned real-token spans, FP32 (module docstring)

mismatch.rule: same family; different parent, gold and before-state; equal prompt token count if available else nearest (ties -> longer donor); rng(mis_seed) among ties; right-aligned, k = min(n_i, n_j) positions

additions.T2S_dmis: h <- h_own + (T(j) - S(j)) at every real prompt position, j = the T2S_mis donor, right-aligned, prefill only
additions.HlowT: Supa with Titan's blocks 0..L-1 at every position (in-place per-tensor splice, hash-checked)
additions.HupT: Titan with Supa's blocks 0..L-1 at every position (in-place per-tensor splice, hash-checked)

_derived.rule: FR = (acc - A_S)/(A_T - A_S) on changed items; HI FR >= 0.7, LO FR <= 0.2, else MID; undefined if A_T - A_S < 0.1; 95% CI: paired parent-cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 17; T2S_mis/T2S_dmis on exact-length pairs only
